cases.sentence: Ответь мне, когда я взываю к тебе, ___ мой оправдывающий меня.
cases.explain: Бог is the direct address, functioning as a predicate nominative, taking nominative case.

cases.sentence: Когда мне было тесно, ты вывел меня на ___.
cases.explain: The preposition на (to/into) indicating direction takes the accusative case.
Молитву is the direct object of the transitive verb услышь (hear), taking accusative case.

cases.sentence: Люди, как долго вы будете меня чернить? Как долго будете любить ___?
cases.explain: Пустое is the direct object of the verb любить (love), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Задумайтесь об этом на ___ ваших и успокойтесь.
cases.explain: The preposition на (on) with location takes the prepositional plural case ложах.

cases.sentence: Приносите ___ правды и уповайте на Господа.
cases.explain: Жертвы is the accusative object of приносите (offer), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Да озарит нас ___ лица твоего, о Господь.
cases.explain: Свет is the subject of the verb озарит (will shine), taking nominative case.

cases.sentence: Ты наполнил мое ___ радостью большей, чем у тех, у кого зерно и вино.
cases.explain: Сердце is the direct object of the transitive verb наполнил (filled), taking accusative case.

reading.ru: Ответь мне, когда я взываю к тебе, Бог мой оправдывающий меня.
reading.question: What does the psalmist ask God to do when he calls out?
options: Answer him, God who vindicates him
Give him over to his enemies
reading.correct: Answer him, God who vindicates him
reading.explain: The psalmist calls on God to answer him, affirming that God is the one who brings him righteousness.

reading.ru: Когда мне было тесно, ты вывел меня на простор. Помилуй меня и молитву мою услышь.
reading.question: What has God done for the psalmist in the past, and what does he now request?
options: Previously freed him from distress; now asks for mercy and to hear his prayer
Abandoned him in times of trouble
reading.correct: Previously freed him from distress; now asks for mercy and to hear his prayer
reading.explain: The psalmist recalls God's past deliverance and now appeals for continued mercy and attention.

reading.ru: Люди, как долго вы будете меня чернить? Как долго будете любить пустое, искать ложь?
reading.question: What questions does the psalmist pose to his opponents?
options: How long will they dishonor him and pursue vanity and lies?
How long will they serve the Lord faithfully?
How long will they prosper in righteousness?
How long will they seek God's truth?
reading.correct: How long will they dishonor him and pursue vanity and lies?
reading.explain: The psalmist challenges those who attack him, asking how long they will continue in falsehood.

reading.ru: Знаете, верного Господь себе отделил. Господь услышит, когда я к Нему воззову.
reading.question: What assurance does the psalmist offer about God's relationship with the faithful?
options: The Lord has set apart the faithful for himself and will hear his cry
The Lord abandons the faithful to their enemies
No one can know God's will
reading.correct: The Lord has set apart the faithful for himself and will hear his cry
reading.explain: Despite opposition, the psalmist expresses confidence that God claims the faithful as His own.

reading.ru: Гневаясь, не грешите. Задумайтесь об этом на ложах ваших и успокойтесь.
reading.question: What is the psalmist's advice about anger and reflection?
options: Be angry but do not sin; reflect quietly on your beds and be at peace
Suppress anger and deny it completely
reading.correct: Be angry but do not sin; reflect quietly on your beds and be at peace
reading.explain: The psalmist acknowledges anger but calls for reflection and restraint rather than sinful action.

reading.ru: Ты наполнил мое сердце радостью большей, чем у тех, у кого зерно и вино в изобилии.
reading.question: What comparison does the psalmist make about his joy?
options: His heart is filled with greater gladness than those who have abundant grain and wine
Joy comes only from physical abundance
reading.correct: His heart is filled with greater gladness than those who have abundant grain and wine
reading.explain: The psalmist values spiritual joy above material prosperity, claiming deeper satisfaction in God.
